reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: §14 termination requires only written notice with services running to the end of the following month, with no termination fee, minimum-term buyout or stipulated amount payable by Client.

No Customer-payable liquidated damages or penalties appear in the cited clauses; the §5(a) monthly minimums are an ordinary pricing floor for services actually provided, not a stipulated damages amount, and the anti-spam covenant in §7 carries no per-message penalty.
Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is identical to the original paragraphs and no counterparty comment is proposed; deterministic checks flagged nothing.
The rationale correctly notes the blank monthly minimums as a pricing observation rather than escalating it under this rule, avoiding double-flagging.
